test_case.test_name: Parameterized 60-second all-GPU RVS GST SGEMM exerciser
test_case.purpose: Run the exact single-precision GEMM stress concurrently on every approved GPU for duration 60000 and validate compute plus per-device health against approved limits.
required_package: Pinned RVS/GST, ROCm and driver artifacts/schema
Exact sgemm.conf preserving alpha=1, beta=0, matrices/LDs 4096/8192, device=all, parallel=true, target_stress=100000, duration=60000, log_interval=5000
Stable GPU UUID/BDF map and expected count
Workload isolation, cooling/power/timeout aborts and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After artifact, config, topology, oracle and load approval, run `/opt/rocm/bin/rvs -c /opt/rocm/share/rocm-validation-suite/conf/sgemm.conf` with the verified source-equivalent configuration and retain the complete RVS log plus synchronized per-GPU utilization, clock, temperature, power, ECC/XID and link evidence. FRU data is not SGEMM evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected GPU participates for the full duration, the approved RVS/performance oracle is met, and no unacceptable throttling, ECC/XID, PCIe/xGMI, thermal, power, kernel or BMC fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact artifact/config provenance, all-GPU full-duration execution, approved oracle and clean per-device health. FRU output, exit zero or tail fragments cannot pass; absent thresholds prevent PASS.
safety_gate: All-GPU SGEMM is active load requiring explicit approval and cooling/PSU headroom.
Pin targets by UUID/BDF and isolate other workloads.
Enforce the source duration and timeout; do not use this short case to replace a formal long-duration test.
Abort on missing GPU, RVS error, XID/ECC/link or thermal/power fault; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Distinct Source Key/Variant identities for SGEMM and UBB FRU
GPU map and full timestamped RVS log
Approved oracle comparison, kernel/BMC logs and return-to-idle proof
test_case.recovery: Stop only the tracked RVS process, preserve full logs/state, verify all GPUs and links return healthy and idle, and use only approved service/reboot recovery if necessary. Do not rerun automatically.
